# 💬 Support Response

## Acknowledgement
Confirm receipt without promising an unverified resolution time.

## Safe reproduction details
Ask for entry point, timestamp/timezone, Python/package versions, synthetic input and sanitized error text.

## Troubleshooting performed
List steps and outcomes.

## Resolution or escalation
Describe confirmed fix or responsible next team.

## Safety reminder
Never request passwords, tokens, private records or browser cookies.
